name: Quick Trim
description: Trim video to a specific start and end time.

name: Convert MP4 → WebM
description: Re-encode to WebM/VP9 for smaller files and broad compatibility.

name: Convert WebM → MP4
description: Re-encode to MP4/H.264 for maximum compatibility.

name: Reduce File Size (Aggressive)
description: Heavy compression — 720p, veryfast preset, low audio bitrate.

name: Reduce File Size (Moderate)
description: Balanced compression that keeps quality and resolution.

name: Downscale to 720p
description: Resize to 1280×720 using lanczos scaling.

name: Downscale to 480p
description: Resize to 854×480 using lanczos scaling.

name: Downscale to 360p
description: Resize to 640×360 using lanczos scaling.

name: Change Frame Rate to 30fps
description: Force the output to 30 frames per second.

name: Change Frame Rate to 24fps (Cinematic)
description: The classic cinematic 24fps frame rate.

name: Change Frame Rate to 60fps
description: High-frame-rate 60fps for smooth motion.

name: Extract Still Frame / Thumbnail
description: Extract a single frame at the 2-second mark as a JPEG image.

name: Rotate 90° Clockwise
description: Rotate the video 90° clockwise.

name: Rotate 90° Counter-Clockwise
description: Rotate the video 90° counter-clockwise.

name: Rotate 180°
description: Flip the video upside down.

name: Flip Horizontal (Mirror)
description: Mirror the video horizontally.

name: Flip Vertical
description: Flip the video vertically.

name: Mute Video (Strip Audio)
description: Remove the audio track entirely from the video.

name: Max Quality Archive Export
description: CRF 15, slow preset, 320k audio — the highest quality export.

name: Slow Motion 0.5×
description: Half speed — video and audio slowed together.

name: Slow Motion 0.25×
description: Quarter speed — extreme slow motion.

name: Speed Up 2×
description: Double speed — video and audio sped up together.

name: Speed Up 4× (Timelapse)
description: 4× speed — classic timelapse.

name: Speed Up 8× (Fast Timelapse)
description: 8× speed — fast timelapse. Strips audio.

name: Reverse Video
description: Play the video backwards. Both video and audio reversed.

name: Boomerang Loop
description: Creates a forward-then-reverse loop effect.

name: Extract Audio as MP3
description: Rip the audio track to MP3 at 192kbps, 44.1kHz.

name: Extract Audio as WAV (Lossless)
description: Rip the audio track to uncompressed WAV at 48kHz.

name: Extract Audio as AAC
description: Rip the audio track to AAC at 256kbps.

name: Normalize Audio (Loudness Standard)
description: Apply EBU R128 loudness normalization.

name: Podcast Processing
description: Highpass 80Hz, lowpass 15kHz, loudnorm, neutral volume — the podcast chain.

name: Bass Boost
description: +12dB on the bass band.

name: Treble Boost
description: +10dB on the treble band.

name: Add Echo Effect
description: Cascade echo with 200ms delay and 0.4 decay.

name: Add Flanger Effect
description: Jet-plane flanger modulation.

name: Tremolo Effect
description: 5Hz amplitude modulation at depth 0.7.

name: Vibrato Effect
description: 5Hz frequency modulation at depth 0.5.

name: Audio Speed Up 1.5×
description: Speed up just the audio track to 1.5× without affecting video.

name: Audio Slow Down 0.75×
description: Slow down just the audio track to 0.75× without affecting video.

name: Blockbuster Orange & Teal
description: Hollywood-style warm highlights and cool shadows.

name: Moody Dark Cinematic
description: High-contrast, low-saturation, blue-shifted shadows.

name: Warm Golden Hour
description: Warm sunset glow with extra red and yellow.

name: Cool Moonlight
description: Cool blue-dominant night-time palette.

name: VHS Retro Look
description: Vintage VHS with color bleed, scan lines, and film grain.

name: Vintage Film
description: Faded, slightly desaturated film with a vignette.

name: Sepia Tone
description: Classic brownish sepia via channel mixer.

name: High Contrast Black & White
description: Saturation to zero, contrast pushed to 1.4.

name: Desaturated / Bleach Bypass
description: Half-saturation, high-contrast bleach-bypass look.

name: Neon Cyberpunk
description: Cranked saturation, hue shift, channel split, and lagfun trails.

name: Dream / Ethereal
description: Soft glow, gentle blur, and a white fade-in.

name: Night Vision
description: Green-tinted low-light look with strong noise.

name: Film Grain + Vignette
description: Heavy grain with a subtle vignette.

name: Cross Process
description: Channel-mixed cross-processed look.

name: High Key Bright
description: Bright, low-contrast dreamy highlight look.

name: Invert / Negative
description: Invert all colors (film negative).

name: Datamosh Simulation
description: lagfun + tmix + tblend difference — fake datamoshing.

name: RGB Channel Split
description: Split the R and B channels by 15 pixels.

name: Scanline Corruption
description: Inverted scanlines every 3 pixels.

name: VHS Tracking Error
description: Horizontal-shift glitch with VHS-style noise.

name: Frame Ghosting
description: tmix across 15 frames for heavy ghost trails.

name: Warp / Melt
description: Sin/cos warp distortion across the frame.

name: Edge Detect Wireframe
description: Sobel-style wireframe edge detection.

name: Posterize (Limited Colors)
description: Quantize each color channel to 3 bits — 8 levels per channel.

name: Color Corruption
description: Per-frame geq color corruption. Each frame re-evaluates the corruption expression using random(1+N), so the effect actually flickers and shifts per frame. This is a SLOW filter (FILTER_COST.geq = 100) and the cost guard will warn on long clips — recommended for clips under 30 seconds.

name: Frame Amplify (Motion Trails)
description: Amplify inter-frame motion differences.

name: Instagram Post (Square 1:1)
description: 1080×1080 square for Instagram posts.

name: Instagram Reel / TikTok (9:16)
description: 1080×1920 vertical for Reels and TikTok.

name: YouTube Short (9:16 Vertical)
description: 1080×1920 vertical for YouTube Shorts with max quality.

name: Twitter/X Video (16:9)
description: 1280×720 for Twitter/X. Note: max 2:20 duration.

name: Discord Embed (< 8MB)
description: Aggressive compression to fit Discord's 8MB upload limit.

name: WhatsApp Status
description: 720p, 30 seconds max — fits WhatsApp status constraints.

name: Video to GIF (Standard)
description: 480px wide, 15fps, palette-optimized.

name: Video to GIF (High Quality)
description: 640px wide, 24fps, palette-optimized.

name: Video to GIF (Tiny/Fast)
description: 320px wide, 10fps — tiny and fast.

name: Reverse GIF
description: Reverse the video first, then export as a GIF.

name: Strip All Metadata (Privacy)
description: Removes all metadata from the output file.

name: Add Copyright Watermark
description: Stamp "© Your Name 2026" in the bottom-right corner.

name: Preview First 10 Seconds
description: Trim to the first 10 seconds and stream-copy (no re-encode).

name: Fade In + Fade Out
description: Black fade in (2s) and black fade out (2s) with matching audio fades.

name: Letterbox (Add Black Bars)
description: Pad to 1920×1080 with black bars around the video.

name: Bass-Boosted Dubstep Mastering
description: Heavy sub-bass boost with surgical EQ — for dubstep, trap, and bass music.

name: Country Trap Mastering
description: Warm low-end with scooped mids and crisp highs.

name: Slushwave Recipe
description: Pitched-down, lo-fi, washed-out vaporwave — the canonical slushwave sound.

name: Tidal Ghost Ultimate
description: Pitched-down ghostly texture with phaser, flanger, deep echo, and mastering.

name: Ultimate CD Mastering
description: Clean, professional CD-quality mastering chain. Multi-band EQ, compression, limiting, normalization.

name: CD Mastering (Dual Compression)
description: Two-stage compression for punch and glue. Radio-ready loudness.

name: Slushwave Bass Preservation
description: Slushwave with extra bass body. Heavier than the standard recipe.

name: Daycore Phonk Slush
description: Deep-pitched phonk with crushed dynamics and dark atmosphere.

name: Ambient Drone v4
description: Transform any audio into an ambient, droning soundscape.

name: DriftWave Mastering
description: Slightly pitched-down with warm compression and smooth limiting.

name: VHS Warp Audio
description: Audio equivalent of a worn VHS tape. Warbled, echoed, compressed.

name: Cyber Grind Bass
description: Extreme sub-bass boost for industrial, cyber, and grindcore aesthetics.

name: Ethereal Wash
description: Dreamy, washed-out audio with cascading echoes and chorus.

name: Nightdrive Echo
description: Late-night driving soundtrack vibe. Long echoes, warm mids, gentle high-end.

name: Lo-Fi Tape Decay
description: Degraded, decaying tape sound. Muffled highs, warm lows, flutter and hiss.

name: Digital Glitch Wash
description: Stuttering, phased, tremolo-washed audio with micro-echoes.

name: Void Bass Texture
description: Sub-harmonic bass enhancement for dark, void-like textures. Pure low-end power.

name: Crystal Mesh Wash
description: Shimmering, crystalline audio with layered echoes and chorus.

name: Midnight Cascade
description: Pitched-down with cascading flanger and warm compression. Dark and flowing.

name: LAGFUN MASSACRE MELTDOWN
description: The complete 6-step visual destruction pipeline. Vaporwave color grade → lagfun ghost trails → RGB chromatic aberration → strobe cuts → rapid chop → final melt.

name: Maximum Entropy Lagfun Massacre
description: tmix frame stacking + tblend averaging + cranked saturation + RGB shift. Pure visual chaos.

name: Echo Ghost Video
description: Triple-blend lighten effect creating ethereal motion ghost trails.

name: Lagfun Dynamic Decay
description: Lagfun with a sine-wave-modulated decay factor. Trails pulse in and out rhythmically.

name: Stacked tblend Difference
description: Triple-stacked tblend difference128 — extracts pure motion as neon wireframes.

name: Flip/Mirror Chaos
description: Frame-count-based alternating horizontal and vertical flips. Disorienting kaleidoscopic chaos.

name: Reverse Video + Audio Echo
description: Reversed footage with layered audio echoes that play forward over the reversed visuals.

name: Speed Slowdown + Bass Boost
description: 75% speed with pitch-shifted bass enhancement. Screwed & chopped aesthetic.

name: 3-Way Alternating FX
description: Cycles between 3 different effect treatments every 24 frames. Hue-shifted → noisy lagfun → color-boosted tblend.

name: VHS Scan Lines
description: Interlaced scan line effect with drawbox + scale combination.

name: I-Frame Strip (Datamosh Prep)
description: Forces extreme keyframe distance for datamosh-style compression artifacts. Lower CRF = more artifacts.

name: Vocal Removal (Karaoke)
description: Center-channel cancellation. Removes (or attenuates) lead vocals from a stereo mix. Works best on tracks where vocals are panned center.

name: Isolate Center (Vocals Only)
description: Crude vocal isolation: average the L+R channels, then band-pass 200-8000 Hz to remove bass bleed and high hiss.

name: Stereo → Mono
description: Collapse stereo to mono. Uses -ac 1 (auto-mix to single channel).

name: Mono → Stereo
description: Duplicate the mono signal to both L and R channels.

name: Swap Left / Right
description: Swap the L and R audio channels.

name: Noise Gate (Remove Room Tone)
description: Attenuate audio below -50 dB. Falls back to a high-pass filter if agate is not compiled into the wasm build.

name: De-Esser (Notch 6kHz)
description: Apply a narrow EQ notch around 6kHz with -6dB gain to tame sibilant "ess" sounds.

name: Telephone Effect
description: Band-pass 400-3400 Hz to simulate a phone call, plus a gentle compressor.

name: Megaphone / PA System
description: Band-pass 500-4000 Hz with a hard compressor and +3.5 dB boost. Sounds like a megaphone.

name: Radio / AM Broadcast
description: Narrow band EQ 300-5000 Hz with a +1.6 dB boost. Sounds like AM radio.

name: Underwater
description: Heavy low-pass + multi-tap echo + tremolo. Sounds like being submerged.

name: 8D Audio (Rotating Pan)
description: Auto-pan the audio at 0.08 Hz using apulsator. Falls back to tremolo if apulsator is not compiled in.

name: Pitch Up +5 Semitones (Chipmunk)
description: Shift pitch up 5 semitones without changing tempo via asetrate + aresample + atempo.

name: Pitch Down −5 Semitones (Deep)
description: Shift pitch down 5 semitones without changing tempo.

name: Nightcore (+Pitch +Tempo)
description: The classic nightcore treatment: shift up 1.25× and speed up 1.25× via the Section 26 pitch + tempo controls.

name: Screwed & Chopped
description: Slow the audio, add a +6 dB bass boost, and a long echo.

name: Sample Rate → 48 kHz
description: Resample audio to 48 kHz (broadcast / video standard).

name: Sample Rate → 44.1 kHz
description: Resample audio to 44.1 kHz (CD standard).

name: Waveform Video (Line)
description: Turn audio into a music video. Cyan line waveform on black, 1280×720, 30 fps.

name: Waveform Video (Point Scatter)
description: Peak-to-peak (p2p) waveform on black — a classic album-art look.

name: Spectrum Analyzer Video
description: Log-scale spectrum with the "fire" colormap.

name: Frequency Bars
description: Vertical bar visualizer using showfreqs. Like a hardware EQ.

name: CQT Music Spectrum
description: Constant-Q transform spectrum. Higher resolution at low frequencies — better for music.

name: Audiogram (Waveform over Image)
description: Classic podcast/music promo. Requires 2 files in the bin (audio + image). Use the Visualizer agent or Batch Apply to assemble.

name: Vinyl Spin Audiogram
description: Spinning vinyl-style cover with waveform pulse. Requires 2 files (audio + image). Combines rotate on the image with a centered waveform.

name: Full Music Video (Spectrum + Video)
description: Overlay a translucent spectrum on the bottom of an existing video. Requires a video + an audio file in the bin (handled by the agent).

name: Concatenate (Sequential Join)
description: Joins selected bin files in order. Uses the concat demuxer with -c copy when formats match; re-encodes otherwise.

name: Side-by-Side (Horizontal)
description: Stack two videos horizontally. Both are auto-scaled to the same height (720).

name: Stacked (Vertical)
description: Stack two videos vertically. Both are auto-scaled to width 1280.

name: 2×2 Grid (4 files)
description: Lay four videos out in a 2×2 grid using xstack.

name: Picture-in-Picture
description: Second video is scaled to 25% and overlaid in the bottom-right corner (20 px margin).

name: Add Soundtrack to Video
description: First file = video (visual). Second file = audio (soundtrack). Output: video from first + audio from second.

name: Replace Audio Track
description: Same as Add Soundtrack but explicit. Video from file 1, audio from file 2.

name: Mix Two Audio Tracks
description: Mix two audio files together with amix=inputs=2:duration=longest:dropout_transition=2.

name: Image Watermark Overlay
description: Overlay an image from the bin on top of a video, top-right, 10% opacity.

name: Crossfade Two Clips
description: xfade transition between two clips. 1 second fade. Use the Compositor agent for full transition control.

name: Green Screen Composite
description: Key out a green (or any color) background from the first file, then overlay it on the second file.

name: Blend Two Videos
description: Blend two videos together. Default mode is "addition" with 50% opacity. Use the Compositor agent for the full blend-mode dropdown.

name: Full CRT Monitor
description: CRT curvature + scanlines + chroma bleed + vignette + slight blur.

name: VHS Tracking Error
description: Random line displacement + noise + chroma bleed. Classic VHS glitch.

name: Signal Dropout
description: Random black frames + static bursts. Lost-signal aesthetic.

name: Interlaced Broadcast
description: Interlace then deinterlace, leaving comb artifacts. Looks like an old TV capture.

name: Film Projector
description: Grain + vertical jitter + vignette + warm grade + occasional white flash.

name: Old Film Scratches
description: Grain + random vertical white lines. Damaged film look.

name: Betamax Degrade
description: Heavy chroma bleed + low-res scale-down and back up + soft blur. The 80s home-movie look.

name: Security Camera
description: Desaturate + low fps + slight noise + 4:3 crop. Looks like CCTV footage.

name: Thermal Vision
description: Color-channel mix that biases the image toward a heat palette (warm reds and yellows).

name: Night Vision (Green Phosphor)
description: Green-channel boost + grain + vignette + slight blur. Night-vision goggles look.

name: Cartoon / Cel Shade
description: Posterize + edge detect + composite edges over the flattened colors. The cel-shaded comic look.

name: Oil Painting
description: Heavy box blur + unsharp + posterize. Imitates an oil-paint surface.

name: ASCII Art Video
description: Extreme downscale + posterize + upscale with nearest-neighbor. The ASCII aesthetic.

name: Halftone Print
description: Posterize + geq dot pattern. Mimics newspaper halftone printing.

name: Pixel Art (Nearest Neighbor)
description: Scale to 128 wide with neighbor flags, then back up. Crisp pixel art.

name: Duotone (Two-Color Map)
description: Map luminance onto two chosen colors via color-channel mixer. Black shadow → blue midtones → cyan highlight.

name: Solarize
description: Invert the upper half of the tonal range. Classic photographic effect.

name: Neon Edge Glow
description: Edge detect with colormix mode + saturation boost + gaussian-blur bloom. A glowing edge look.

name: Chromatic Bloom
description: Bright areas bleed color. Boost saturation + add a soft blur for a bloom look.

name: Kaleidoscope
description: Symmetric mirror effect. Crop a quadrant, hflip, and vstack/hstack the four reflections.

name: Mirror (Left → Right)
description: Split horizontally, hflip the right half, and hstack the two halves.

name: Infinite Zoom (Droste)
description: A looping zoom-in via zoompan with an exponentially growing zoom expression.

name: Ken Burns Zoom In
description: Slow zoompan push from 1.0× to 1.3× over the source duration.

name: Ken Burns Zoom Out
description: Pull-back zoompan from 1.3× to 1.0× over the source duration.

name: Handheld Camera Shake
description: Subtle sinusoidal crop offset. Looks like a hand-held camera.

name: Speed Ramp (Slow → Fast)
description: Slow → fast. The classic YouTube-intro ramp. Use the Speed slider for the slow factor.

name: Freeze Frame Punch-In
description: Freeze a frame, hold 1.5s, zoom 1.2×. Use Section 30 Freeze controls for the timestamp.

name: Stutter / Frame Hold
description: Frame-hold rhythm. Use the Workflows agent for the full stutter pattern; here we apply a moderate setpts=2.0 effect.

name: Loop 3 Times
description: Loop the input 3 times. Uses -stream_loop 3.

name: Ping-Pong Loop (Boomerang)
description: Forward + reverse concat. A boomerang loop.

name: Podcast Audiogram (1:1 Square)
description: 1080×1080 square. Requires an audio file + a cover image in the bin (use the Visualizer agent). Uses the audiogram pattern.

name: Blurred-Background Vertical (Reels / Shorts)
description: Landscape source → 9:16 vertical. The background is a blurred, scaled-up copy of the video, the original sits centered. The standard Reels/Shorts treatment.

name: TRUE Datamosh — Smear
description: Real bitstream datamoshing. Deletes the I-frames so orphaned motion vectors smear the old scene along the new one. This is NOT a tblend approximation — it is the actual effect.

name: TRUE Datamosh — Bloom
description: Duplicates P-frames so their motion vectors are applied repeatedly, pushing the image outward. The classic datamosh "bloom".

name: TRUE Datamosh — Total Destruction
description: I-frame removal AND P-frame duplication. Maximum bitstream corruption.

name: Databend
description: Real databending — corrupt the raw bytes of the encoded stream and decode through the damage with error concealment on. Genuine byte-level glitch, not a filter.

name: Pixel Sort — Masked
description: Sorts only the pixels whose brightness falls inside a mid-tone band, leaving shadows and highlights intact — the selective look, not the whole-frame smear. A real per-frame sort applied to every frame.

name: Pixel Sort — Diagonal
description: The masked sort, run along a 45° axis so the streaks fall on the diagonal instead of the scanline. Rotate → sort the band → rotate back.

name: Lens — Vintage Wide
description: A named-lens profile: radial barrel/pincushion distortion plus real chromatic aberration that grows toward the edges — the physical fingerprint of a vintage wide lens. Not a filter preset; an actual per-pixel radial remap.

name: Lens — Cctv
description: A named-lens profile: radial barrel/pincushion distortion plus real chromatic aberration that grows toward the edges — the physical fingerprint of a cctv lens. Not a filter preset; an actual per-pixel radial remap.

name: Lens — Anamorphic
description: A named-lens profile: radial barrel/pincushion distortion plus real chromatic aberration that grows toward the edges — the physical fingerprint of a anamorphic lens. Not a filter preset; an actual per-pixel radial remap.

name: Lens — Tele Pincushion
description: A named-lens profile: radial barrel/pincushion distortion plus real chromatic aberration that grows toward the edges — the physical fingerprint of a tele pincushion lens. Not a filter preset; an actual per-pixel radial remap.

name: Curve — Film Contrast
description: A gentle S-curve on the master tone curve — lifts the shadows a touch and rolls off the highlights for a filmic contrast, the classic first move in a grade. Piecewise curve through real control points, applied per frame.

name: Curve — Faded Matte
description: Raises the black point and pulls the whites down — the “lifted blacks” matte look, done on the tone curve rather than a wash overlay.

name: Secondary — Punch the Sky
description: A colour-selective grade that keys just the blue of the sky and deepens it — more saturation, a touch darker — without touching skin or foliage. A real HSL secondary, not a global push.

name: Secondary — Warm the Skin
description: Keys the orange skin-tone band and warms it slightly while leaving the rest of the frame alone — the classic skin secondary.

name: Power Window — Spotlight
description: Grade just part of the frame — a feathered elliptical window in the centre with a brightness/contrast lift, so the subject pops and the surround sits back. The colourist’s spotlight, per-region and edge-blended.

name: Power Window — Darken Surround
description: The inverse window — leaves the centre alone and pulls the edges down, a soft graded vignette that isn’t just a black overlay.

name: Deflicker (timelapse)
description: Evens out the exposure flicker that plagues aperture-priority timelapses — tracks a smoothed running brightness and scales each frame onto it, killing the fast jitter while keeping the slow day→night change.

name: Rolling Shutter (jello)
description: Simulates the CMOS rolling-shutter wobble — each row is captured a hair later, so the frame skews and wobbles like handheld phone video during fast motion. A per-row time-skew model, not a filter.

name: De-jello (correct skew)
description: The inverse — counter-shears each row to straighten a rolling-shutter skew, taking the lean out of fast-pan footage.

name: Timelapse 4× (motion blur)
description: Speeds the clip up 4× the right way — instead of dropping frames (which strobes), it BLENDS the frames it skips, so motion smears smoothly like a long exposure. The timelapse look without the stutter.

name: Film Grain
description: Real plate-based film grain — silver-halide clumps with actual spatial structure, luma-weighted so it lives in the mids and fades in the blacks and highlights. The plate shifts each frame like a physical negative. Not per-pixel digital noise.

name: Halation & Bloom
description: A physical light-bleed pass — the brightest highlights are thresholded, blurred, tinted red, and screened back so they bloom and bleed into their surroundings the way real film halates around blown-out light. Not procedural noise.

name: Feedback Tunnel
description: The infinite video-feedback tunnel. Each frame re-draws the last one zoomed and rotated a touch, fading as it goes, so any detail spirals outward forever. Runs offline over the whole clip.

name: Feedback Vortex
description: The tunnel wound tighter — stronger zoom, faster spin, longer trails. Everything gets pulled into the swirl.

name: Match Colour to a Reference
description: Upload a still from a film you like. Generates a 3D LUT that transforms your footage into its colour palette. Pure statistics — no model.

name: ⚡ Hardware Transcode
description: Re-encode on the GPU via WebCodecs — the same silicon Chrome uses to play YouTube. 10–50× faster than WebAssembly.

name: ⚡ Hardware Glitch (GPU shader)
description: Decode on hardware → run a TRIP CAM shader on the GPU → encode on hardware. The pixels never touch the CPU.

name: Motion Mosh — Classic Smear
description: The real thing. Motion vectors from each new frame, applied to the old picture. The scene drags itself into the next one.

name: Motion Mosh — Total Liquefaction
description: Small blocks, long search, nothing ever refreshes. The image never recovers.

name: Motion Mosh — Pulse
description: Moshes for 24 frames, then lets a clean frame back in. Breathes. Good over a beat.

name: Motion Mosh — Bloom
description: Big blocks, hard vectors. The picture pushes outward and blooms.

name: Motion Mosh — Compression Death
description: Motion mosh PLUS a real JPEG re-encode every frame at quality 0.2. Genuine DCT blocking, because it is genuine DCT blocking.

name: Motion Mosh — Ghost Trails
description: Gentle vectors, very long persistence. Motion leaves a trail instead of tearing the frame apart.

name: Motion Mosh — Scene-Cut Only
description: Clean most of the time — then detonates on every scene change. Cuts are where moshing looks best, because that is exactly where the codec would have inserted a keyframe and we refuse to.

name: Motion Mosh — Horizontal Smear
description: Directional mosh — the vertical component of every motion vector is killed, so the whole image drags sideways. The classic horizontal datamosh streak.

name: Motion Mosh — Vertical Drip
description: Directional mosh biased to the vertical axis — motion bleeds up and down like the picture is melting off the screen.

name: Motion Mosh — Masked Mosh
description: Only the moving parts tear — everything still stays sharp. Motion-magnitude masking keeps the background clean while the subject smears.

name: Motion Mosh — Amplified Chaos
description: A non-linear amplification curve pushes every motion vector toward the max — even gentle motion detonates into a full smear.

name: Motion Mosh — Bloom Push
description: Applies each frame’s displacement four times over, pushing the picture outward and blooming with every pass.

name: Flow Warp — Liquid
description: Uses each frame’s own optical flow as a displacement map — the picture warps like liquid exactly where the scene moves, and stays sharp where it’s still. Not a datamosh tear; a smooth bilinear warp.

name: Flow Warp — Heat Haze
description: A gentler flow warp — subtle shimmer that ripples the moving parts like heat off tarmac.

name: Flow Warp — Riptide
description: Small blocks, long search, heavy scale — the whole frame is dragged into the current. Everything that moves smears violently.

name: Motion Vectors — Overlay
description: Draws the estimated motion field as green arrows over a dimmed version of the frame — the codec’s-eye view of your footage. The overlay is on by default; genuinely useful for dialling a mosh in, and a striking look on its own.

name: Stabilise
description: Steadies shaky footage using the same motion estimation as the mosh — the median of each frame’s field IS the camera’s motion, so it integrates the camera path, smooths it, and counter-shifts each frame. The intended pan survives; the shake goes.

name: Slow-Mo (optical flow)
description: Real slow motion — synthesises the in-between frames by warping along the motion field, so movement lands at its true intermediate position instead of juddering on duplicated frames. 2× smoother slow-mo from any clip.

name: Slow-Mo (frame blend)
description: The other retime method — cross-dissolves neighbouring frames instead of warping along the motion. Cheaper and softer than optical-flow slow-mo (moving objects ghost rather than land sharp); the classic frame-mix look. Pair with “Slow-Mo (optical flow)” and pick per shot.

name: Auto-Reframe → Vertical
description: Turns a horizontal clip into a 9:16 vertical one that FOLLOWS the action — it tracks the centre of motion (the subject) and pans the crop to keep it in frame, instead of a dumb centre crop that loses whatever’s moving.
